## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The "Restore the empty-criteria guard" finding must be fixed before merge. The new counting logic treats a requirement with no criteria as proven, and the PR body says no behavior change is intended.

## Changes
Across 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files, the pull request replaces `typing.List`/`typing.Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning`. It also switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites `requirement_proven` to compare a sum against `len(criteria)`, and adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Restore the empty-criteria guard in requirement_proven — With `criteria=[]`, `requirement_proven` now returns `True`, because `sum(...)` is `0` and `len(criteria)` is `0`. The old `bool(criteria) and all(...)` returned `False`. Line 10 logs "requirement has no criteria" and then execution continues into the success result. — Release review now marks requirements with no criteria as proven, which contradicts the PR body's "No behavior change is intended". — Fix: Return `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` again (or return `False` inside the `if not criteria:` branch), and add an empty-list case to `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py`.

(none)

- This review checked the changed lines of the 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files by pattern matching against the mechanical `typing`/`log.warning` substitutions; it did not read those files in full.
